Every class page has a Popular builds fold under the trees now: the spec split, the five complete builds people shared, saved and opened most (one click loads any of them), the talents almost everyone takes and almost nobody takes, and a switch that paints each talent's pick rate onto the tree. It comes from the site's own visit counts for 12 to 17 Sep, 16,176 different builds, aggregated with no identities involved. Recounted since with the days that were missed: 13 to 17 Sep, at least 79,715 builds. See the newer entry.

Every page here was read again against the beta's own files (build 70170, with the 1 to 2 Oct Warrior hotfixes), the in-game recordings and Wowhead, and what no longer held is fixed. The headlines: Combustion lasts 3 crits on the Mage guide, the same as Classic, not 4. Purification reads the same as Classic, so the Shaman guide counts 30 changed talents, not 31. A talent that slid along its row now reads Moved, not Same as Classic: Frostbite, Elemental Focus, Blackout and seven more. Dual Wield Specialization keeps 10 to 50% off-hand Rage under the hotfix, where the 1 Oct entry here said it lost it. Where a guide's video says something a later build changed, like the Gnome's Eureka! no longer helping a Warlock's DoTs since 1 Oct, a line under the guide's video says so. And older entries below that a later fix reversed, like Lightning Reflexes at 3% a rank, now point to the fix. If anything still looks off, say so and it gets checked.
